plugins.name: Programming Hygiene
plugins.summary: Observability, performance, and function-length hygiene review and fix task sources for agent-manager.
plugins.description: Adds observability, performance, and function-length review and fix task sources for agent-manager. The review tasks triage deterministically flagged issues (silent catches, unguarded loops, OTel naming; sync I/O in loops, sequential awaits, deep JSON clones; over-long functions) as genuine or false-positive, and the fix tasks consume Strong candidates into real code fixes.
